test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
From among the words given in bold, select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

Women’s **vulnarability **due to the denial of ownership of productive resources has been **focused **on in the **analysis **of how **progressive **laws shaped gender relations.
solution:
The correct answer is '**vulnarability**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word in bold that is incorrectly spelled in the given sentence is "**vulnarability**".
 
• The correct spelling is "**vulnerability**".
 
• "**Vulnerability**" refers to the quality or state of being exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally. (भेद्यता)
 
 
• **Example**: **Vulnerability **in cybersecurity can lead to significant data breaches, affecting thousands of users.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct spelling is **vulnarability**.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **analysis**: This option is correctly spelled. It refers to the detailed examination of the elements or structure of something. (विश्लेषण)
 
• **progressive**: This option is also correctly spelled. It pertains to favoring or implementing social reform or new, liberal ideas. (प्रगतिशील)
 
• **focused**: This option is correctly spelled and means paying particular attention to. (केंद्रित)
